seo.title: About Us — Our Story, Team & Milestones
seo.description: Learn how IncubXperts grew into an AI-native engineering partner, our journey, key milestones, and the team behind our AI-first delivery.
seo.summary: IncubXperts, founded 2017, is an AI-native engineering partner with 150+ experts and 95% client retention.

blocks.title: Leaders in technology, partners in progress
blocks.subtitle: Founded in 2017, we have grown into an AI-native engineering partner for product companies and enterprises.

blocks.heading: A decade of building intelligent software
paragraphs: IncubXperts was established in 2017 as a private limited organisation, with a focus on helping companies design, build and scale software that matters.

Marked 10 years of IncubXperts, a decade of building AI-native software and technology solutions. Scaled our AI Bootcamp program threefold, from 36 to 99 associates, shipping working AI agents across document processing, remittance automation, loan underwriting, and Salesforce-based sales workflows.

IncubXperts embraces its identity as an AI-native engineering partner, integrating AI into how we operate, design, build, and deliver systems with a focus on purpose-built solutions that create real impact.

blocks.heading: Work with us the way that suits you

steps.title: Time and Materials (T&M)
steps.body: Extend your team with the flexibility to ramp up or down as needed. Ideal for projects with evolving requirements or iterative development needs.

steps.title: Pilot Project
steps.body: Our no-commitment trial service period, which will give you an insight into our process, our work ethics, and help you evaluate a fit.

steps.title: Milestone-based Model
steps.body: A combination of T&M and FP - we usually advise this where there is progressive clarity on scope.

steps.title: Fixed Price
steps.body: We adopt this model when the project scope is well-defined and the work aligns closely with our core areas of expertise.

steps.title: PureShore
steps.body: Our volume business model specifically created for large teams. Delivers the best ROI by leveraging economies of scale.

steps.title: Managed Services
steps.body: We own the business function and deliver selected services with a focus on reliability, scalability, and SLA-driven outcomes.
